integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, photorealistic CG render, an extreme close-up frames the young woman shown in <Picture 1>, preserving her appearance, makeup, hair, gold-tassel earrings, white embroidered hanfu collar, and the cold-toned blurred outdoor backdrop with the soft rim light on her hair. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she holds her calm, detached gaze straight into the lens; loose strands of hair drift across her cheek in a gentle breeze, her chest rising and falling with slow breaths, and her eyes shift almost imperceptibly as she blinks slowly once. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a tighter close-up on her eyes and brow as her lashes tremble, her brows knit almost imperceptibly, and a faint sheen of tears wells up along her lower lash line, her red lips parting slightly with a barely audible intake of breath. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up with the camera pulling back with small amplitude at slow speed as she lowers her gaze and turns her head slightly to one side, a single tear tracing down her cheek past the dangling pearl earring, her expression softening into quiet sorrow as the breeze lifts her hair and the shot holds on her face as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A soft breeze passes through the open air, rustling fabric and loose strands of hair. Her slow, measured breathing is faintly audible, joined by one quiet sniffle as tears gather, and the delicate chime of the pearl earring swaying with her movement.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse guzheng pluck with a faint wooden flute line at a slow tempo, joined by a low sustained string pad, staying hushed and restrained and fading out softly at the end.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, fitness-comedy style with bright gym lighting and energetic color grading — a single wide horizontal shot of five people standing in a neat row, each performing a different exercise simultaneously, creating a chaotic yet comedic ensemble. The camera holds a static wide shot, then slowly pushes in at medium speed. From left to right: The first person is a young athletic man with short black hair wearing a grey tank top and black shorts — he jogs in place with high knees, his arms pumping rhythmically, sweat flying, a determined grin on his face. The second person is a woman with a red high ponytail wearing a sports bra and leggings — she performs slow deep squats, descending to a perfect parallel position and rising, her arms extended forward, expression focused. The third person is a heavyset man with a buzz cut in a loose blue t-shirt — he does push-ups on the floor, his body lowering and rising with effortful groans, his face reddening with strain, the floor beneath him slightly sweaty. The fourth person is a girl with twin braids in a yellow hoodie — she jumps a rope at high speed, the rope a blur, her ponytails bouncing, landing lightly on her toes, a playful smile on her face. The fifth person is a man with wavy brown hair in a white tank top — he dances with exaggerated flair, waving his arms, swaying his hips, doing a spin, clearly having the most fun of the group. The camera continues its slow push-in, capturing the five contrasting movements in one frame — the rhythmic jogger, the steady squatter, the straining push-upper, the bouncing rope-jumper, and the joyful dancer — their motions overlapping in comedic disharmony. The shot holds on the full row as the push-in completes, then fades.

overall_soundscape: A cacophony of exercise sounds — the rhythmic thud of jogging feet, the creak of deep squats, the heavy exhales and groans of push-ups, the rapid whir and slap of the jump rope hitting the floor, and upbeat dance music playing from the dancer's direction. Mixed heavy breathing and occasional giggles. The gym's ambient hum underneath.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat energetic fitness track with a driving beat, syncing loosely with the movements — the tempo matching the jogger's rhythm, the bass hitting on the squatter's rise, a percussive accent on each push-up, and a playful melody overlapping for the dancer's section, then fading out.
